ZH.Who — Round 5, Thirty Options

Thirty options across seven threads — Underground 2 tuner, cyberpunk, Tron, Fast & Furious muscle, motorsport livery, weaponised, and chrome. Every one has a nameable feature: a strange @, a broken counter, a slice, a bevel, an extreme proportion. Previous rounds were rejected for being bold squared sans with nothing to point at, so that is now an automatic cut. The pattern behind all of it: every canonical reference is custom lettering, not a font — the Cyberpunk 2077 logo and its UI, the Tron Legacy titles (Danny Yount / Prologue), the Fast & Furious logotype where the chrome is a finish rather than a typeface, Akira, Ghost in the Shell, Ducati, Yamaha, and NFSU2's own UNDERGROUND band. None can be bought. These carry the traits; the exact thing gets drawn. Ideas, not licence-cleared assets.

Underground Band

Freeware / personal-use — not cleared for merch

Sheared terminals, chamfered joins, slit counters, ~15° lean — and horizontal slices cut clean through every stroke. Five of the six target traits in one cut, and the closest thing to the real UNDERGROUND lettering.

Small-size risk: Unicase. Slices need size to survive.

32

Stamped Badge, Cut

Font
Aircruiser Punch Regular Italic
Cuts
generated — 7.0 unit pitch, 38% duty
Tracking
natural
Licence
Freeware / personal-use — not cleared for merch

Card 26's inline punch and outer keyline, with card 28's slat density cut through it — a 7.0-unit pitch, matching the 11 bands measured off Bomber Escort Grad. The slices are genuinely transparent, so the surface behind shows through them. A 2.4-unit rim along every edge is shielded from the cuts, so the badge's own linework stays continuous and only the solid interior gets striped.

Small-size risk: Display-only. The cuts are a mask, not contours — flatten before cutting vinyl.

ZHW ZHw ZhW Zhw zHW zHw zhW zhw

Production files are in this folder as NN-slug.svg. They are plain outlined SVG — open in Illustrator, Inkscape, Affinity or Cricut Design Space, or hand them to a printer as-is. Each file holds exactly two paths, one gold and one red, so colour separation is already done.

The keyline toggle previews a bone-coloured sticker border. Most print shops generate the actual die-cut contour themselves from the artwork outline, so send the flat files unless yours asks for a cut path.
